items.title: Gabber vanishing for a closed subscheme of a normal integral affine scheme with separably closed function field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the vanishing of the higher etale cohomology of finite constant coefficients on a closed subscheme of a normal integral affine scheme with separably closed function field (statement lines 14444-14450). The proof (proof lines 14452-14464) shows the local rings of the closed subscheme are strictly henselian, verifies the vanishing of H^1 on principal opens through the lift to a normal domain, and applies Gabber's criterion. H2: two verifications plus one criterion.
